title: California Business and Professions Code section 7071.10 - Form and beneficiaries of the qualifying individual's bond
claims: Section 7071.10 provides that the qualifying individual's bond shall be executed by an admitted surety insurer in favor of the State of California, in a form acceptable to the registrar and filed with the registrar by the qualifying individual.

Section 7071.10 provides that the qualifying individual's bond shall not be required in addition to the contractor's bond when the individual proprietor has qualified for the license by personal appearance, or the qualifier is a general partner, as set forth in Section 7068(b).

Section 7071.10 provides that the bond is for the benefit of a homeowner contracting for home improvement upon the homeowner's personal family residence damaged by a violation of the chapter by the licensee; a property owner contracting for construction of a single-family dwelling damaged by such a violation, who shall only recover if the dwelling is not intended for sale or offered for sale at the time the damages were incurred; a person damaged by a willful and deliberate violation of the chapter or by the fraud of the licensee in the execution or performance of a construction contract; an employee damaged by the licensee's failure to pay wages; and a person or entity to which a portion of an employee's compensation is paid by agreement, damaged by the licensee's failure to pay fringe benefits.

Section 7071.10(e) provides that damage to a person or entity under that subdivision is limited to employer payments required to be made on behalf of employees of the licensee, as part of the overall compensation of those employees, which the licensee fails to pay.
